articleBrief.primaryIntent: Compare two Mac storage scans to investigate where space went, without confusing missing files or changed allocation with cleanup savings.
articleBrief.title: Find what grew on your Mac with saved Radix scans
articleBrief.description: Use Radix’s documented snapshot comparison to narrow a storage-growth investigation, check scan coverage, and review files before deciding what to remove. This is a documentation-led guide, not a hands-on benchmark.
articleBrief.distinctFromComparison: A before/after investigation and coverage checklist, not a feature-matrix expansion.
outline: Start with the changed-folder question, not the largest-file question. Put the official scan-comparison visual after the lead.
Keep a baseline scan for a chosen folder or volume; label time, target and exclusions.
Compare a later scan with that baseline; inspect grew/shrank/appeared/disappeared entries and confirm coverage before interpreting missing items.
Search and inspect the changed branch; use Quick Look and Finder context without assuming cache or personal-file removability.
Review candidates in Discard Pile; back up originals, consider rebuild costs and separate Trash moves from free-space changes.

When periodic scans answer the question, stay with Radix; if activity context is needed, introduce Breathing Room, which we build, with preview/hosted limitations. Show the labeled Space browser preview here.

interactionPass.decisionAid: Read-only coverage checklist: same target? comparable exclusions? unreadable locations? APFS shared allocation? ownership and rebuild cost understood? If not, investigate before cleanup.
interactionPass.implementation: Handoff only; research stage creates no website widget or executable cleanup example.

radixAdvantages.text: Documented sunburst/treemap visualization and portable read-only snapshots for explicit scan-to-scan comparison.
Advertised free, local, no-account workflow; MIT-licensed source.

radixTradeoffs.text: Requires macOS 14+, and permissions can limit scan coverage. A snapshot difference is not process-level attribution.
Continuous activity/helper tracking and developer-specific cleanup methods remain not verified; do not present them as absent.

breathingRoomAdvantages.text: Documented app/helper CPU/memory and activity context complement a storage investigation; local tools are free.

breathingRoomTradeoffs.text: Non-notarized preview with Python prerequisite, physical Intel validation limits, hosted AI/account boundary and optional recurring AI Care pricing.
